newsitem.title: CROATIA: Zagrebacka peaks in active trade.
newsitem.headline: Zagrebacka peaks in active trade.

text.p: Zagrebacka Banka ordinaries peaked at an all-time high of 2,410 kuna in active trade on the Zagreb Stock Exchange on Monday, market participants said.
Of 2,500 shares sold by midday (1000 GMT), 200 shares were traded at 2,410 kuna, overshooting Friday's close by 60 kuna.
Some 1,500 bank's E-series preferred shares were sold at a steady 1,500 kuna, said one trader with a dominant market share.
Zagrebacka's deals spearheaded very intense activity on the bourse, which usually does not see much trade before the last hour of the session (1100-1200 GMT).
"There were some 100 transactions by noon, which is a lot for that time of day," the trader added.
Among other fully-listed stocks, repair docks Viktor Lenac fell nine kuna to 171 on a smaller volume.
Drugs firm Pliva held ground at 560 kuna.
Karlovacka Pivovara brewery, a subsidiary of Chile Cervercerias which trades in a semi-regulated segment added 10 kuna to Friday's close to reach 560 kuna. It sold 700 shares.
